Tessera plugin VERSION for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 10.15 or later)
================================================================================

In this folder:
  Tessera.clap        the CLAP instrument (Bitwig, Reaper, ...)
  Tessera.vst3        the VST3 instrument (Ableton Live, Cubase, ...)
  Tessera.component   the Audio Unit (Logic Pro, GarageBand, MainStage)
  Tessera.app         the standalone app: no DAW needed

Each runs natively on Apple silicon and on Intel Macs.

Install
-------
1. Copy each plugin to your own Plug-Ins folders (in Finder: Go > Go to Folder..., paste the path):
     Tessera.clap       to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/
     Tessera.vst3       to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
     Tessera.component  to  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
   (Make the CLAP folder if it isn't there.) Tessera.app can go in Applications.
2. SIGNING (see below).
3. In your DAW, rescan the plugins. Tessera is an instrument, under "Tessera". Logic finds the Audio
   Unit under AU Instruments > Tessera > Tessera; if it doesn't, restart Logic, or the Mac.

Signing: "damaged" or "can't be verified"
-----------------------------------------
SIGNING_NOTE

The manual for the plugin: https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/blob/main/PLUGIN.md
What's in this beta, and what isn't yet: BETA_NOTES.md in this folder.
Found a problem? https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/issues (the plugin's version, your DAW and its
version, macOS' version, Apple silicon or Intel, the steps, what you expected and what happened).
